title: Tartu Art Museum

terrainReference.basis: Measured elevation field sampled just beyond the short southern square frontage.

mapIdentity.scope: The four-corner building at Raekoja plats 18 is individually mapped by address and Wikidata. The shortest edge faces Town Hall Square, with the Kompanii long wall to the west.

note: The museum’s written description supplies the 5.8° lean and three storeys. The architectural study anchors the direction of settlement, the rusticated base, the fluted pilasters and frieze, and the bracketed balcony over the square entrance. The mapped hipped roof and municipal height tag guide the section.
